prompt_template: Photorealistic recruitment campaign photograph, FULL-LENGTH WIDE SHOT: fictional French municipal police {SCENE}. Subjects shot from a distance, SMALL IN THE FRAME: ENTIRE BODY(IES) VISIBLE FROM HEAD TO SHOES, perfectly centered horizontally, the full figure occupies only about HALF of the image height: top of head at about 42% of the image height, shoes at about 92% with a strip of ground visible below, wide empty sky / background in the top 40% of the frame. Officers wear EXACTLY the uniform of the first reference image: dark navy blue jacket with a horizontal light-blue band across chest and arms, black duty belt with pouches, navy trousers with thin light-blue side stripe, black boots. Shoulder patch matching the second reference image. Cinematic, editorial advertising photography, sharp, real-looking people, not cartoon, no text added.
final_deliverables: PRESENTATION dossier campagne A4 paysage (couverture, concept, vue d'ensemble, 1 page par affiche, déclinaisons, contact E-DUST)
Post LinkedIn : Tarik / E-DUST offre gratuitement cette campagne aux polices municipales pour leurs recrutements (personnalisable : blason, QR, contacts ; personnages fictifs IA)
rule_fit: span pieds-tête <= 0.53 de la hauteur image ; top = 1565 - pieds_frac*1860 ; tête doit rester >= 590
